scientific_integrity: Mathematical arguments and bounded finite arithmetic checks are supplied; no independent audit or third-party certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: The computed invariants concern the coarse order-55 quotient over the complex numbers; integral torsion, rationality, intersection cohomology and quotient by the full automorphism group are not determined. Prior literature may implicitly subsume parts of the classification.
title: Five quotient singularities and rational cohomology of the Klein cubic's order-55 quotient
